title: Indigenous initiation ceremonies for contact

tellings.quote: talk to people in um Native American tribes exactly yeah AB original Australians indigenous Australian tribes and they've had they even even have these you know different initiation Ceremonies for it

plain: A researcher named Diana Pasulka, who studies UFOs and religion, told podcast host Jesse Michels that contact with other kinds of beings is nothing new to many Indigenous peoples. She says that Native American tribes and Aboriginal Australian tribes have long known about such contact, and even have their own initiation ceremonies for it. If so, what modern people call UFO encounters would have a much older place in human spiritual life.
